summary: Carry the character's own balance and positional advantage from Lich to the viewer

coordination.notes: Additive only. DR prints a balance/position line every combat round and Lich already parses it into DRStats.balance and DRStats.position (a signed -9..+9 advantage scale from DR_POSITION_VALUES in lib/dragonrealms/drinfomon/drvariables.rb, DR's port rather than GemStone's side). The bridge reads 20 other DRStats fields and not these two, so no new parsing is needed anywhere - only forwarding. Extends the existing PlayerSnapshot from #278 rather than adding a parallel structure. Godot-side rendering is Codex's; this is data only. The installed copy in C:/Ruby4Lich5 is NOT being touched: an older installed script simply omits the fields and the client treats them as absent.
